summary: Promo discount is shown in the cart total but never charged: ScreenCart's promoCode is local state; snapshotOrder (index.html:133), ModalPayChoice total (:205/:211), Stripe (:196) and ScreenConfirm all recompute from cart at full price*qty.
failure_scenario: User applies WELCOME10, cart shows 26,82 € (29,80 − 10%), taps 'Valider ma commande'. Order snapshot, payment modal, and confirmation all charge/show 29,80 €. Customer shown a discount, billed full price (the exact 'risque légal' the cart comment at screens-main.jsx:595 claims to have fixed).

summary: Loyalty rules box advertises config.earn_ratio = '10 pt par € dépensé', but the cart preview (:661), the points-gain modal (screens-modals.jsx:249/251) and every order grant Math.round(total) ~ 1 pt/€. earn_ratio is consumed nowhere else.
failure_scenario: Rules promise 10 pt/€; a 13 € order shows/records +13 pts and a 30 € order +30 pts — 10× fewer than advertised.

summary: ScreenCart receives a go wrapper `(s)=> s==='confirm' ? go('pay') : go(s)` that declares only one param, dropping the 2nd arg; ScreenCart's upsell calls go('item', it.id) (screens-main.jsx:673/680) so the item id is lost.
failure_scenario: Tap an item in the cart 'Pour accompagner ?' upsell → go('item', id) → wrapper calls go('item') with ext=undefined → setItemId skipped (index.html:166) → ScreenItem renders the previous/null item ('Plat introuvable').

summary: Bol-supplement allergen aggregation reads lcMenu.supplementsBols.find(...).allergens, but SUPPLEMENTS_BOLS (menu.js:175-180) has no allergens field, so bol supplements are omitted from the FIC 1169/2011 disclosure the code claims to build.
failure_scenario: User adds 'Boule gratinée' (cheese → lactose); s.allergens is undefined → nothing added. Recap allergen list omits lactose: legal/safety disclosure gap (no crash, guarded by || []).

summary: Cart upsell filters i.cat === 'sides' || 'drinks' || 'desserts', but window.ITEMS.cat holds canonical slugs ('frites','boissons','desserts'); 'sides'/'drinks' match nothing.
failure_scenario: 'Pour accompagner ?' only ever lists desserts; fries and drinks (slugs 'frites'/'boissons') never appear.

summary: 'Sans Sauce' exclusivity handled in toggle (line 376, id 's-sans') but render maps only lcMenu.sauces (no 's-sans'); SAUCE step gates Suivant on length>=1 (line 162).
failure_scenario: On a galette/sandwich/burger the user wanting no sauce sees no 'Sans Sauce' option and cannot advance without adding a sauce.

summary: Active order C-1234 prices Tacos L (item_id 502) at line_total 7.90 vs canonical menu.js:452 8.90 — violating orders.js's header invariant ('line_total matches canonical unit price; Sentinel test enforces parity'); no such test exists in the repo.
failure_scenario: In-progress order is 1 € short of SSOT (total 29,80 vs 30,80); the claimed parity guard is absent so the drift is unguarded.

summary: Home featured 'signature' card calls findItem('tacos-xxl') (no such slug; tacos are 'tacos-1-viande'/'big-tacos-2-viandes') → falls back to items[0] = Sandwich Cayenne.
failure_scenario: The SIGNATURE hero meant to feature a tacos renders Sandwich Cayenne instead.

summary: Cart loyalty banner hardcodes 'Plus que 153 pts pour ton burger gratuit'; 153 is the gap to the 500-pt reward, while the burger (reward 5) costs 1000 pts.
failure_scenario: Static copy self-contradicts (153 points → 500-pt €5 reward, not the 1000-pt burger named) and ignores the live balance.

summary: Order id generated via 'C-' + Math.floor(1000 + Math.random()*9000) can collide with the seeded active order 'C-1234' (and history ids C-1100..C-1212).
failure_scenario: Math.random() yields 1234 → new order id 'C-1234' duplicates the existing active order; orders.findById resolves the wrong order on the detail screen.

summary: Formule-drink allergen lookup matches selections.drinkId ('d-coca') directly against item.slug ('coca')/id (1001) with no drinkSlugMap, unlike the parallel bolDrinkId path (:816).
failure_scenario: Latent: any formule drink carrying an allergen would be silently omitted from disclosure (find returns undefined). Harmless today only because no catalog drink has allergens.

summary: Slot fallbackEmoji span uses opacity:0.001 (invisible) although onError (:101) hides the broken img relying on the emoji 'to take its place'.
failure_scenario: If a Slot were given fallbackEmoji and the image 404'd, the emoji stays invisible → blank gray box. No live impact today: no caller passes fallbackEmoji.
